text: The initiative is characterized by its multi-layered approach, including a legal and institutional foundation with the Natural Disaster Management Law and Disaster Management Fund, ex-ante budgetary instruments like contingency appropriations, and participation in regional programs such as SEADRIF and ADRFI. It also involves contingent financing through World Bank projects with a Contingent Emergency Response Component (CERC).

metadata.solution_name: Earthquake-Related Government Risk Financing Initiatives in Myanmar (2020–2025)
